## Which file do I need?

| You want to… | Download |
|---|---|
| Play straight away on any computer | **cognitive-terrain-0.14.2.html**, then double-click it to open in your browser |
| Read the rules | **Cognitive-Terrain-Field-Manual-0.14.2.pdf** |
| Install it like a normal program | **…-Setup.exe** (Windows), **…-macOS-AppleSilicon.zip** or **…-macOS-Intel.zip** (Mac), **…-Linux.tar.gz** |
| Host it on itch.io | **…-web.zip** |

The installers are not code-signed yet, so Windows and macOS warn on first
launch. **PLAYTEST-README.txt** explains how to get past the warning.

Two-player games work between any of these files, as long as both players
use version 0.14.2.

## What's new

- **Source check.** Every real-world claim in the game and the manual was
  checked against the cited research. Wording was tightened where it went
  further than a source (section references, two quotations, the AI Agents and
  AI Vulnerability Mapping years now marked as estimates, which innovation
  scores are the paper's and which are the designer's), and text that is a
  game assumption is now labelled as one. No statistic or quotation had to be
  removed.
- **How Olvana fights.** Olvana now has its own "Know your opponent" cards in
  the game and its own field manual page (24), with the same detail as
  Donovia's: what each rule does, where it comes from, and where Olvana is
  weak. Rules that are design assumptions rather than findings from the
  sources say so.
- **Both opponents side by side.** Page 23 lists the rules both opponents
  share; pages 24 and 25 cover what is unique to each, with tips for beating
  them and a designer's note on how each should feel to play against.
- The field manual credits the ODIN DATE site by address. The manual is now
  28 pages.
- No rule changes. Two-player codes work between 0.14 builds.
